Admission needs a utility account whose smart meter has logged twelve months of draw. The applicant files the account number, the node reads the distributor's interval archive, and premises under 120 kWh a month count as vacant. One seat a premise, rechecked per billing cycle, so a shed wired to one lamp never grows eligible.

Fifty clones need fifty premises a year out: 250 to connect, 300 deposit, 45 a month standing charge, 1,090 each, 54,500 total. An orchard pump, a grove bunkhouse and a dune cabin read differently in that archive. A tenancy is proved by a year of light bills.
